obligations.instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. obligations.instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Within every affected region, preserve the source surface's native material identity, local texture, thickness, lighting, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion while the chosen rule changes its coordinates or correspondence; the error must follow the three-dimensional scene rather than cut and move a flat image plane. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.

render_gates.description: Lens, sensor, exposure, and image surface read as clean photographic capture rather than a damaged display or file.
The scene establishes an immediately familiar and physically coherent baseline before the contradiction is inspected.
Exactly one spatial, temporal, causal, optical, or topological invariant supplies the governing error rule.
At least three affected surfaces repeat the same measurable displacement, lag, dependency, correspondence, or recursion.

Within every affected region, native material identity, local texture, lighting, thickness, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion remain coherent under the shared rule; source pixels or facial texture are not stamped onto unrelated surfaces.
Unaffected anatomy, objects, perspective, lighting, and materials remain internally coherent and physically plausible.

The contradiction appears at the deliberately selected reveal strength, immediate or delayed, while remaining clearly authored, subordinate to one inferable world rule, and distinguishable from generic image failure.

A screen effect, split seam, collage, visible translucent shell, enclosing splash ring, portal, magical rift, flat image-plane slice, particle dissolve, or random anomaly stack does not substitute for the repeated world rule.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can state the single failed world rule and point to at least three separated instances that share its same measurable relation; merely saying that something looks wrong fails.
An isolated malformed hand or face, fused object, broken texture or text, accidental reflection or shadow mismatch, or other familiar synthesis defect does not carry the reality-error concept.

semantics.definition: An ordinarily intangible field or a monolithic environmental surface itself becomes a handleable layer in the depicted world, rather than a separate covering, printed representation or ordinary flexible object. One acting hand or held tool contacts that same layer; its continuous local deformation leads to a readable still-attached boundary. An exposed reverse, substrate or recessed interior plus material-specific folds, sag, thickness, occlusion or contact shadow makes the handling visible in an otherwise coherent scene. Peeling, creasing, gathering, rolling and unzipping are distinct alternatives. No second creature, repeated cross-surface world rule or non-Euclidean doorway is required.
paraphrase_examples: An adult pinches a patch of the dusk sky and lifts it like a sheet; cloud texture crosses the curled flap, its dark reverse is exposed, and the still-attached edge casts a narrow shadow.
A worker gathers the sea surface into folds between both palms; the water pattern stays on the continuous sheet, the troughs sag, and the underside occludes the harbor below.
